title: BST服务器
description: 这个mc服务器只是一个普普通通的生存服务器This Minecraft server is just an ordinary survival server.
body:
> **这个服务器是在中国地区，我们无法确定海外玩家能和国内玩家有一样的体验**

我们不需要正版就可以进入我们的服务器，使用了Lophine这一强大的folia fork来确保至少不是服务器的问题。

那么我们服务器有什么点是值得你来的呢？

- 死亡不掉落
- 整个管理层对玩家友好
- 有技能系统，称号系统等都不需要你充值即可使用
- 任务丰富
- 比较支持生电
- 支持 Simple Voice Chat 和 Plasmo Voice 一起讲话
- 添加了一些原版根本没有的方块和物品

服务器目前没有Discord，你需要进入我们的交流QQ群：**978266921**

> **This server is located in China, so we cannot guarantee that overseas players will have the same experience as domestic players.**

No premium account is required to join our server. We use Lophine, a powerful Folia fork, to ensure that the server side, at the very least, is not the issue.

So what makes our server worth joining?

- Keep inventory
- Friendly and approachable management team
- Skill system, title system, and more—all available without any microtransactions
- Abundant quests
- Supportive of technical Minecraft and redstone automation
- Support for both Simple Voice Chat and Plasmo Voice for in-game communication
- Added various blocks and items that don't exist in vanilla Minecraft

The server currently does not have a Discord server. You will need to join our QQ group: **978266921**
